company_name: ACCIO Hong Kong Catalonia Competitiveness Agency Limited
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company supports semiconductor industry growth through economic development and investment facilitation rather than direct manufacturing or technology provision.
summary: ACCIO Hong Kong Catalonia Competitiveness Agency Limited, representing Catalonia Trade & Investment, aids international companies in expanding and innovating within the semiconductor sector in Catalonia, Spain. They provide tailored support including market intelligence, site selection, and connections with key industry stakeholders.

regional_presence.Asia Pacific: The agency has offices in Beijing, Hong Kong, Seoul, Shanghai, Sydney, and Tokyo to strengthen business ties between Asia Pacific and Catalonia.
